seo.title: BLD Southeast 2026 - Washington, DC | September 16-17, 2026
seo.description: Sept. 16-17, 2026. Join B Corps & mission-driven professionals in Washington, DC to learn & connect at the BLD Southeast conference.

hero.headline: The future of business is built by those who dare to care, cultivating legacy through thriving communities.

about.heading: Back for our sixth year
about.body: We're back for our sixth year of BLD Southeast, and this year we're bringing our impactful event to the dynamic, historic, and influential nation's capital: Washington, D.C.

whyAttend.heading: Why attend BLD Southeast
whyAttend.intro: Two days built for people who believe business can be a force for good — and want the tools, network, and community to prove it.

benefits.title: Learn from conscious-business practitioners
benefits.description: Sessions and conversations drawn from B Corps and mission-driven leaders putting people-and-planet practices to work every day.

benefits.title: Connect with the B Corp community
benefits.description: Meet founders, operators, and advocates from across the Southeast and beyond who are building companies around a stronger bottom line.

benefits.title: Support local B Local communities
benefits.description: Every ticket helps fund the regional B Local organizations that keep the conscious-business movement growing where you live.

agenda.heading: Full Agenda
agenda.placeholderNote: Full agenda coming soon — check back for Day 1 (Sept 16) and Day 2 (Sept 17) session details.

overview.label: Day 1 — Wednesday, September 16
overview.summary: Optional morning and afternoon excursions across DC — Capitol tours, museum visits, and walking tours — capped by the opening reception at the Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library.

overview.label: Day 2 — Thursday, September 17
overview.summary: The main conference day at GW's Student Center: keynotes, four blocks of concurrent sessions, a congressional plenary, and the closing reception at Tonic at Quigley's.

overview.label: Bonus — Urban Hike · Friday, September 18
overview.summary: A guided ~5-mile urban hike visiting B Corps across Georgetown and downtown DC, ending at Luke's Lobster Farragut.

sessions.description: Meet inside Western Market (2000 Pennsylvania Ave NW). Breakfast not provided. *Note: please pay for your own meal.

sessions.title: Lunch
sessions.description: Options: food court at the Longworth Dining Hall / lunch outside with Bart Houlahan (Independence Ave SE); food court at the National Museum of African American History and Culture (1400 Constitution Ave NW); or Compliments Only (2029 P St NW, Front 1). *Note: please pay for your own meal.

sessions.title: National Portrait Gallery
sessions.description: Meet in the museum lobby (8th St NW & G St NW).

sessions.title: Black History Walking Tour
sessions.description: Meet outside Ben's Chili Bowl (1213 U St NW). Paid excursion (signup link coming soon).

sessions.title: BIPOC Happy Hour at Busboys and Poets
sessions.description: Meet in the Community Room at Busboys and Poets (2021 14th St NW). Attendees who don't identify as BIPOC but would like a drink beforehand can meet at Urban Garden Brewhouse (624 T St NW), DC's first Black woman-owned brick-and-mortar brewery — a table will be reserved for BLD Southeast.

sessions.title: Opening Reception at Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library
sessions.description: 5th-floor event space & rooftop terrace (901 G St NW). Registration, brief opening and closing remarks, networking, complimentary food & beverages, library access, and live music (TBD).

sessions.title: George Washington University – Student Center
sessions.description: 800 21st St NW, Washington, DC 20052. Enter through the main entrance on 21st St and take the elevators to the third floor.

sessions.title: Sponsor table setup
sessions.description: Sponsors: we recommend arriving in this window to set up your table.

sessions.title: Opening Remarks
sessions.description: DC Mayor-Elect Janeese Lewis George invited (TBD).

sessions.description: Sen. Chris Van Hollen (MD), Rep. Chrissy Houlahan (PA), Rep. Jamie Raskin (MD), and a business representative (TBD). Moderated by George Chmael II (Council Fire).

sessions.title: Closing Session — Continuing Our Collective Work Together
B1 Happy Hour (B Corp & 1% for the Planet members)
sessions.description: Third floor of Tonic at Quigley's (2036 G St NW). Hosted by local Patagonia store Engagement Leads.

sessions.title: Closing Reception
sessions.description: Across all floors of Tonic at Quigley's (2036 G St NW). Silent auction (prizes from 1 Hotel South Beach, andCo, and Bodhi Surf + Yoga), live raffle (West Paw, Every Man Jack, and more), complimentary food & beverage, and networking.

sessions.title: ~5 miles · ~2 hours walking (3–3.5 hours total with stops)
Start at the Lincoln Memorial
sessions.description: 12 min / 0.5 mi walk from Hotel Hive. Continue to the MLK Memorial (10 min / 0.4 mi), then along the Rock Creek Trail / Potomac riverfront to Georgetown, passing the Kennedy Center, the Watergate Hotel, the C&O Canal, and the Exorcist Steps.

sessions.title: Georgetown along M St
sessions.description: See B Corps along the way: Aesop, Athleta, Warby Parker, Marine Layer, Cotopaxi, Monos, Sézane, L'Occitane en Provence, Patagonia, East Fork, and Le Labo. Then continue to the Farragut / White House area (Just Salad, Longchamp, the White House).
